page.layout: One page of text, with an ornamental border above the heading. Heading centred in capitals with title lines. Body text in one column, drop cap at the start. One marginal note in the right margin beside the second and third lines of the body paragraph. Catchword at the lower right, signature at the lower left. Faint "Digitized by Google" credit at lower right, not transcribed.

main_text.l: ab occidente in orientem porrectæ, ideoq;
omnibus ferè rebus ejus magnis bello
ac pace implicita; denique Reip. formâ
præ cæteris insignis, atque optimè habens.
sim quædam de eâ differere, & explica-
nostratis. Et primùm quidem de agro
dicam breviter, in quo urbs sita est,
tum de ipsa urbe, de jure Ultrajectino,
de pactis & foederibus ejus, de conatu

page.notes: The circular ink stamp on the right margin and the stamp marks in the margin are not transcribed. The note "Summa operis ordo." is partly overprinted by a stamp; its wording is read from the visible letters. Catchword "armis" is printed at the lower right with a bracket-like flourish. Signature "A" is printed at the lower left.
